== Summary ==
Identified: [[Kevin Jaap]] (standing, glasses, white graphic tee, pint), [[Emil Wallin]] (seated, blonde bun), and [[Cedrik Vanderhaegen]] (seated, black tee and grey jeans; same face as [[:File:Cedrik Vanderhaegen 2023 European Championship.jpg]] and [[:File:2023 Naboo Regionals 19.jpg]]). The Jack & Jones shirt in the foreground is the same person as the pink shirt in [[:File:2023 Naboo Regionals 2.jpg]]; his face is out of frame.

The 2023 Naboo Regionals ("Foil Fest") weekend in Liverpool, UK (2–4 June 2023), hosted by Team Wales.

* '''Event:''' [[2023 Regional Championships]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2023-05-31
* '''Identification:''' [[Kevin Jaap]] (standing, glasses, white graphic tee, pint), [[Emil Wallin]] (seated, blonde bun), and [[Cedrik Vanderhaegen]] (seated, black tee and grey jeans; same face as [[:File:Cedrik Vanderhaegen 2023 European Championship.jpg]] and [[:File:2023 Naboo Regionals 19.jpg]]). The Jack & Jones shirt in the foreground is the same person as the pink shirt in [[:File:2023 Naboo Regionals 2.jpg]]; his face is out of frame.
